# Vendored terminal assets

Served locally; no browser CDN requests or Node build step.

- `@xterm/xterm` **5.5.0**: `lib/xterm.js`, `css/xterm.css`.
- `@xterm/addon-fit` **0.10.0**: `lib/addon-fit.js`.

Downloaded from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/<package>@<version>/<path>`.
MIT license notices are retained in `LICENSE-xterm` and `LICENSE-addon-fit`.
Source-map comments refer to optional debug assets; runtime does not require maps.
